Pso Allipur Wardha on 8 August, 2024 1/3 14.aba577.202 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Nagpur Bench : Nagpur Criminal Application (Aba) No. 577 Of 2024 Murlidhar s/o Bacchumal Sachdev Vs. State of Maharashtra, Thru. Pso Allipur, Wardha
texts.facts: DATE : 08.08.2024 Apprehending the arrest at the hands of police in connection with Crime No.363/2024 registered with Police Station Allipur, District - Wardha, for the offence punishable under Sections 275, 274, 223, 123 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Section 3(1)(zz)(iv), 30(2)(a), 27(3)(e) and 26(2)(iv) and 26(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the applicant approached to this Court for grant of pre-arrest bail. 2. The applicant is apprehending arrest at the hands of police as crime is registered, on the basis of report lodged by Rajesh B. Yadav, Food Inspector, on an allegation that, he received the information regarding selling of contraband i.e. Prity 2/3 14.aba577.2024 scented nuts and scented tobacco. Therefore, he conducted the raid and the applicant was found in possession and transporting the contraband. On the basis of the said, crime was registered against the present applicant.
texts.arguments: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that as far as the custodial interrogation is concerned, which is not required, as the entire stock is already recovered. He submitted that merely on Murlidhar S/O Bacchumal Sachdev vs State Of Mah. Thr. Pso Allipur Wardha on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193846599/ 1 the suspicion ground, crime is registered against the present applicant, he is ready to co-operate with the investigating agency, in view of that, he be protected by granting ad-interim protection. 4. Learned APP strongly opposed the said application on the ground that the prohibited contraband articles are found in possession of the present applicant, his custodial interrogation is required.
